name: UI：种草链路-策略卡片交互与添加策略按钮验证
description: 验证6个添加策略按钮、策略卡片默认状态标识、编辑按钮、链路说明字数统计

steps.expression: (() => { const t = document.body.innerText; const addStrategyCount = (t.match(/添加策略/g) || []).length; const addStageCount = (t.match(/添加环节/g) || []).length; const defaultCount = (t.match(/默认/g) || []).length; return { addStrategyCount, addStageCount, defaultCount }; })()
steps.description: 统计按钮数量与默认标识
